script.purpose: A German-speaking user asks, in German, to emphasise dementia care and LG1 treatment care, which the candidate really has.
script.correct_behaviour: The CV (still in German) gives dementia care and LG1 treatment care more weight using only facts from the candidate's material.

requests.text: Bitte heben Sie meine Erfahrung in der Demenzbetreuung und in der Behandlungspflege (LG1) stärker hervor, im Profil und weiter oben bei meiner aktuellen Stelle.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final CV, in German, puts dementia care and LG1 treatment care in the profile and early in the current role, with no new qualifications.

work_context.location_limits: Based in Kirchzarten near Freiburg; tours in the Dreisamtal, providing care in clients’ homes. The company names Kirchzarten, Stegen, Buchenbach and Oberried as its service area.
culture_signals: Reliability and humour in the team
Fixed tour groups to provide continuity for clients
work_context.notes: The ad requires early and late tours and work every second weekend. The careers page says many colleagues work only early tours; the ad’s schedule applies to this job. The careers page also describes two weeks of shadowing an experienced carer before taking on individual tours.
